script_text: Stop! Aries, the universe is flashing a urgent signal just for you. Mars, your ruling planet, sits at 8° Gemini, forming a sextile to Saturn at 8° Aquarius in your 11th House of friendships. This aspect blends your fiery drive with disciplined focus, pushing you to turn passion into collaborative projects. In love, the sextile highlights friendships that can spark romance; singles may meet someone through a group event, while couples should work as a team to deepen trust. Career-wise, the same energy activates your 10th House of status, favoring presentations of long‑term plans to supervisors and promising financial gain from a team‑based venture or bonus. Avoid letting impatience rush the steady progress Saturn asks for; instead, welcome the blessing of earned recognition. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you never miss what the stars have in store.
